release_notes: Hybrid Light and Dark themes built on shared design tokens; switching themes no longer flashes a white window.
The dashboard now reports total downloads, active and completed transfers, total data and live current speed.
New Refresh button and View > Refresh (F5) reload the download list without disturbing running transfers.
A sort control in the content header orders the list by name, size, date added, downloaded amount, progress, speed or status.
The new Downloaded column shows the bytes received separately from the total size, and the list drops low-priority columns on narrow windows.
New Other Files library destination, sidebar connection status, version chip and a More toolbar menu below 1120 px.
